name: strata-v100-resident-4x
description: IQ3_S fully resident on four V100-32G cards (volta05): cold 1k-256k plus warm 64k/128k/256k.

estimate.basis: 2026-10-26 phase B budget (cold 4x V100 plus three warm cells)

caveats: One allocation must own all four cards; the layer split is not tensor parallel.
The 262144 cell is prefill-dominated with 128-token answers and is not a sustained-throughput measure.
Warm cells rerun the same server and rely on the conversation cache; repeat 1 is the cold reference, not the stored cold number.
Historical phase B shared one staged PLE shard with phases A and E; a standalone rerun pays the Lustre read.
volta05 is a shared node; check that no other job owns cards 0-3 first.
